title: Floquet Theory of the LC Circuit with Modulated Capacitance
summary: Parametric resonance -- periodic variation of a system parameter driving exponential growth of oscillations -- is among the most fundamental instabilities in physics and engineering. The nondissipative LC circuit with harmonically varying capacitance is one of its simplest realizations: the modulation renders the circuit equation a Hill equation with either bounded or exponentially growing solutions.
